description: TU Delft provides post-construction Sand Motor bathymetry and topography schematised to cross-shore transects. The source identifies derived survey material and a custom interval from 3 August 2011 to 7 September 2016. Coverage: 2011-08-03T00:00Z/2016-09-07T00:00Z. Access: public native metadata describes the identified resource. Licence: 4TU General Terms of Use. Current file access and cost are unknown. Provider-specific reuse conditions have not been read where general terms apply. Caveats: Exact transect spacing and interpolation uncertainty are unstated. The native identity represents transects, distinct from actual survey paths and a 20-metre gridded product. Related resources are separately identified in the native collection. The native Sand Motor collection identifies a coastal-protection nourishment and monitoring programme. Simulation use concerns its coastal geometry and sediment or hydrodynamic calibration.
